issue.title: Weekly docs-editor routine that proposes a Guide-update plan from the CHANGELOG, tutorial results, and guide candidates
issue.description:
Deferred follow-up recorded at the sase-1le landing (plan:202610/sase_sh_docs_redesign.md, section "Out of scope and deferred follow-ups"). Filed by the sase-1le land agent on 2026-10-16.

The redesign stops the docs from regrowing with a lint-enforced contract: check_docs budgets and hygiene, the docs_writing.md routing note, and the constrained refresh_docs chop that fixes broken steps only. Nothing yet turns accumulated signals into Guide improvements. Feature agents record "guide candidate" PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes (sase-1m1 is the first one filed), tutorial tests run in the scheduled Full CI lane, and the CHANGELOG records user-visible changes, but nobody reads them together.

Proposal: a weekly routine (a lumberjack chop) that reads the CHANGELOG since the last run, the latest tutorial-test results, and open guide-candidate tasks, and then proposes one docs plan for human approval through the normal plan gate. It never edits Guide pages directly and never moves pages between tabs; information architecture stays a human decision.

The plan explicitly rules out a docs knowledge graph, a retrieval layer, or a support bot. Keep it to one proposing routine.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a weekly chop that reads the CHANGELOG, tutorial-test results, and open guide-candidate tasks, then proposes one docs plan for human approval without editing Guide pages or moving pages itself.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1le plan deferred it on purpose: the routine needs the finished Guide, the routing rule, and real guide-candidate traffic, and it is new automation rather than docs restructuring.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1le docs-redesign plan listed a weekly docs-editor routine as a deferred follow-up to record at landing; the contract stops regrowth but nothing yet feeds guide candidates back into the Guide.
